articles.summary: 20+ updates, including new Scheduling, SEO, Reviews, and Offers agents help operators drive bottom-line impact, backed by real customer outcomes Toast (NYSE: TOST), the global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses, today introduced Toast IQ Team , a new labor management solution for restaurant and retail operators, alongside a significant expansion of Toast IQ Grow , the complete marketing solution Toast introduced earlier in 2026. From building schedules that help manage labor costs to turning great guest experiences into five-star reviews, Toast IQ Team and Toast IQ Grow mark another step toward an agentic platform that absorbs the hardest work of running a business and gives operators measurable proof that it’s working. Restaurant and retail operators juggle everything from scheduling and payroll to marketing, often on thin margins. Many are turning to AI for relief: nearly 9 in 10 restaurant operators surveyed (86%) are experimenting with AI for business
articles.title: New Toast IQ Team and Expanded Toast IQ Grow Help Businesses Drive Profits, Attract Guests, and Manage Labor
